subject: Exporting the UD with probability values rather than quantiles

messages.author: 7f4d93ddb0c6e0d6
messages.subject: Exporting the UD with probability values rather than quantiles
parts:
Hi there,
I was wondering if anyone has been able to export the data (preferable in a georeferenced format such as a raster or GTiff) with the pixel values as probabilities rather than quantiles?
When I export the  UD as a GTiff  it has quantile probability values, I'm looking to delineate core areas based on the median grid value rather than the 50% quantile which is why I would like the probability values.
Also, I didn't have much luck using the raster package, and writing the UD to a raster, it creates a raster but ArcGIS 10.5 fails to import it, has anyone else had this problem? 

Thanks,

Orla Osborne

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Exporting the UD with probability values rather than quantiles
parts:
Hi Orla,

Have you tried writeRaster with arguments format="GTiff" and DF="PDF" or DF="PMF" ?

https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/export.html

Best,
Chris

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Exporting the UD with probability values rather than quantiles
parts:
Hi Orla,

It wouldn't be AKDE if you specified the bandwidth. The bandwidth optimizer, etc., is detailed in the references:
  • https://esajournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1890/14-2010.1
  • https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/2041-210X.12673
  • https://esajournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/eap.1704
The kernel is Gaussian. No other has been generalized to autocorrelated data.

Best,
Chris
